name: Chop: Easily Block Ads and Trackers

ios.desc:
Chop is a simple app that blocks most ads and privacy invading trackers. Letting you enjoy a faster browsing experience. In fact our users find a performance boost of up to 80% in web page loading. 

- Lightning fast
- Blocks more ad networks then the competition
- Blocks privacy invading trackers
- Multitasking support for iPad Air 2
- Enjoy faster page loading
- Outperforms the competition
- Always updating our database for latest Ad Networks

Pro Version Includes: 

- Ability to turn of Disqus comments
- Remove all external loading typography
- Whitelist your favorite websites

Chop works with new iOS 9 Content Blocker feature in Safari. We spent a lot of time going through the list of ad networks and privacy trackers to come up with the best database in the business.
